units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:2">Sabb. VIII, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 78a:9">78ᵃ</cite>) <he>גמי כדי לעשות ת׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. a. Mish. ed. Pes. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400; ed. <cite ref="V00569"><he>תְּלָאי</he></cite>) as much reed grass as is required for the making of a hanger for a sieve &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 3:9">Eduy. III, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:6">Kel. XII, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 12</cite> <he>ת׳ המגררות וכ׳</he> the chain on which the strigils in the bathhouse are suspended.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:4">Kel. XV, 4</cite> <he>ת׳ מקל וכ׳</he> the handle of the constable’s staff.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:4">Ib.</cite> <he>העשוי לת׳ טהור</he> whatever is made for suspending or handling is not susceptible of uncleanness; a. fr.—Pl. <he>תְּלוֹיִים</he>, <he>תְּלוֹיִין</he>, <he>תְּלוֹיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:4">Ib.</cite> <he>כל התלויים … חוץ מתְּלוֹיֵי וכ׳</he> ed. Dehr. (Bab. ed. <he>התלויות תלוי</he>; Mish. ed. <he>התְּלוֹיִם</he>) all hangers or handles are clean except those of &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 6</cite> <he>התלויין</he>.
Yalk. Ps. 624, v. הֲרָמָה; [Pesik. Shek., p. 10ᵇ; Midr. Till. to Ps. III; Yalk. Ex. 3Yalk. Ex. 365 ת׳ ראש lifting up the head, הרמת ראש removal of the head].

senses.gloss: [hanging over,] interlinear writing. Tosef. Gitt. IX (VII), 8 שטר … ת׳ מגופו וכ׳ a document which has an erasure or an interlinear insertion in its body (essential portion, v. תּוֹרֵף) is unlawful; Y. ib. IX, 50ᶜ תלות (corr. acc.).
